title: What Scripture Actually Means When It Says Kill Your Sin, Not Manage It
caption:
"I'm working on it" and "I'm cutting back" are how a man keeps his sin comfortable. Scripture doesn't say manage it. It says put it to death.

That starts with the root, not the habit, and it starts before the temptation shows up, not in the middle of it.

Tell one man today what you're actually killing.
